data.name: Areejab
data.gender_notes: Areejab is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Areej' which means fragrance, and 'ab' meaning breeze. The name Areejab carries the meaning “Fragrant Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Areejab usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who carries the fragrance of faith and good deeds.
data.etymology: Areejab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant Breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Areejab total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عريجب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على تعجب و استغراب و مفاجأة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من العجب و هو يدل على الشعور بالتعجب و الاستغراب الشديد و المفاجأة، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع بمعنى التعجب و الاستغراب، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية و دينية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: عریجب
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو تعجب اور حیرت کا اظہار کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عریجب ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے 'عجب' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تعجب یا حیرت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ان feelings کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو انسان کو اللہ کی قدرت و حکمت پر غور کرنے کے لئے प्रेरित کرتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام روحانی و دینی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: अरीजब
in_hindi.meaning: एक ऐसा नाम जो आश्चर्य और विस्मय को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीजब एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के 'عجب' (अजाब) से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आश्चर्य या विस्मय। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में गहरा अर्थ रखता है, जो आत्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन भावनाओं को प्रकट करता है जो इंसान को अल्लाह की शक्ति और ज्ञान पर विचार करने के लिए प्रेरित करती हैं

in_pashto.name: عجيب
in_pashto.meaning: د حیرانتی او استغراب څرګندونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عجيب د يوه نوم څخه مشتق شوی دی چې د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، په معنی یې د حیرانتی او استغراب څرګندونه کوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړاو لري، او د روحاني او مذهبي پلوه د پام وړ دی

in_english.name: Areejab
in_english.meaning: Name signifies wonder, astonishment, and surprise
in_english.long_meaning: Areejab is derived from the Arabic root 'عجب' (ajab), meaning wonder or astonishment. This name holds spiritual and religious significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting feelings of awe and amazement at Allah's power and wisdom. Historically, the term has been used in various Quranic contexts to express surprise and astonishment. The name Areejab symbolizes a deep sense of reverence and mindfulness in one's faith journey

data.cultural_impact: The name "Areejab" carries a beautiful and captivating quality, both in its meaning and sound. With the popular trend of giving unique names, this name has made a significant impact in the Islamic community. Its name is often given to girls to represent the desire for a life that emanates kindness, beauty, and a delicate elegance. Areejab is a name that will unquestionably stand out among her peers, receiving admiration for its distinctive nature.
data.spiritual_significance: Moreover, the spiritual significance of the name "Areejab" can be found in the fragrance-laden breeze reference to the name. According to Islamic tradition, Fragrance is a symbol of God’s loving presence on Earth. The Yemeni Prophet, Saleh (AS), would share this beautiful account, often recounting to his people the story of God’s mercy being illustrated by the fragrance of flowing rivers and lush gardens in paradise – a constant reminder of God and the sweetness of His nearness. In this sense, the name "Areejab" represents a connection to the Divine. The name is also suggestive of the path to spiritual simplicity and a life filled with closeness to the Creator. The fragrance of the breeze alludes to the sweetness of the remembrance of God, as given in Qur’anic verses such as "And the messenger (Muhammad SAW) will say, 'My Lord, my people have deserted this our religion.' So, cry, O Muhammad, your eyes may sweep down with tears, and your Clara will grieve.” (Al-Fitrah 111:1-2)
